question: You are designing a transformer core to minimize energy losses due to eddy currents. The magnetic field lines in the core travel along the y-axis. Evaluate the following orientations for the laminations (sheets) to determine which design is most effective.

options.A: Stack sheets in the x-z plane (Sheets perpendicular to magnetic field).
options.B: Stack sheets in the x-y plane (Sheets parallel to magnetic field).
options.C: Use a solid block instead of sheets.
options.D: The orientation does not matter, only the insulation matters.
